__comment: SEED / test-grade G1 spec corpus carrying a CAPACITY PRECONDITION (po-av01j.231). `capacity_arg` names the constructor argument that gives the receiver a finite capacity: put blocks only when the queue can fill, so a queue built with no maxsize (or maxsize <= 0) cannot block and the site is not_applicable. Which argument carries that meaning is library knowledge and therefore lives here, never in propagation. PRODUCTION corpus authoring rides the LLM factory and is HITL - these entries exist so the e2e test exercises real verdicts at identities pyindex actually emits, nothing more.

apis.rationale: SEED RC-019: put blocks until a free slot is available if the queue is full; the bound is the per-call timeout= argument, and timeout=None waits forever. A queue with maxsize <= 0 is infinite and never full.
SEED RC-019: same surface as queue.Queue.put
